headlines: Stocktwits posts cite CNBC: US reportedly weighs fresh Iran strikes after midterms; oil jumped overnight
Tesla Q3: profit fell, revenue flat; stock lower after the report. Meta -5.3% on earnings
Long-dated Treasury yields at one-month low as money moves to bonds (TLT +1.1%)
China CSI 300 reportedly entered a bear market; Alibaba hit by new Beijing e-commerce rules
Trending: META -5.3%, NOK -8.2%, IBM -3.2%, LRCX -8.4%, LMT +6.7%, BHVN +29%

rumors.text: US and Israel reportedly weigh fresh strikes on Iran, possibly after the midterms
rumors.why: Higher oil and geopolitical risk pressure the index and lift defense names

rumors.text: Posters say the SPY bounce off the open is a bull trap or dead cat bounce
rumors.why: If the bounce fades, the 760 support area is retested

rumors.text: Tesla results and SpaceX merger talk are dragging the index because of Tesla's weight
rumors.why: A heavy index weight falling adds drag on SPY

rumors.text: Diesel going through the roof; transport stocks are being pumped to prop the market
rumors.why: Rising fuel costs squeeze consumers and margins

plays.reason: Crowd extremely bearish (score 8) yet SPY already recovered from -0.9% premarket to -0.3%; contrarian edge is thin
plays.catalyst: Sentiment extreme versus price holding above 760 support

readings.whats_new: SPY recovered to 766.62 (-0.3%) from -0.9% premarket, while Stocktwits sentiment stays extremely bearish (8). The Iran strike report and oil jump are now the main story; Meta, IBM, LRCX and Nokia fall on earnings and defense (LMT) is bid. VIX is up to 18.2 and fear and greed is about 30.
